Design.title: Design Workspace
Design.description: User custom landing page design containing pages, slides, and free-grid canvas elements.

userId.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

pages.description: The array of Page objects defining the navigation and slides.

elements.description: The canvas elements placed on the pages/slides.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update.

/designs/{userId}.description: The complete workspace design document synced and owned by each user.
